# LoP - LFBB (Bordeaux Control)
> **Reminder**: This document is intended for use by air traffic controllers on the VATSIM network only and is exclusively for flight simulation purposes. It shall not be used for real-world air traffic control operations.
{.is-warning}

Bordeaux Area Control Centre provides en-route air traffic control services within the upper airspace of south-western France. It also manages the sectors serving the major airports located within its area of responsibility.

![ccr_lfbb_fl195-fl660.png](/doc-atc/lfbb/acc/ccr_lfbb_fl195-fl660.png =75%x){.align-center}

The Centre position may be split into three primary sectors: **North (UN)**, **South (US)**, and **FIR**. The FIR sector is responsible exclusively for the lower sectors, from the surface up to FL195.

When the Centre position is operated as a single sector, the **Bandbox** sector assumes responsibility for all sectors described above.

In addition, during events or as operationally required, individual upper sectors may be opened. These sectors are grouped (e.g. **X1–X5**) and provide ATS within their respective vertical limits.

## Control Positions and Limitations
> **Bordeaux Control** is an unrestricted position. Nevertheless, controllers are strongly encouraged to familiarize themselves with this documentation before providing the position.<br>
When no approach positions are staffed, Bordeaux Control shall provide ATS to the underlying aerodromes in accordance with the top-down principle.
{.is-info}

```diagram

```

> The **FIR** sector (SFC–FL195) shall not be opened independently. It may only be operated when both the **North (UN)** and **South (US)** sectors are staffed.<br>
Furthermore, the **North (UN)** and **South (US)** sectors shall not be opened unless **LFBB_CTR** is online.
{.is-danger}
